episodes.title: Odcinek 1
episodes.summary: Young model Filip moves through life with abandon, banking on his carefree charm and charisma to get him out of any situation. But when he's confronted with a serious family tragedy, Filip must decide whether to grow up or risk losing all he has left.

episodes.title: Odcinek 2
episodes.summary: Overwhelmed by the reality of his sister's death, Filip finds himself approaching Tosia's biological father about taking her in. Later, a night of blowing off steam lands Filip on the wrong side of the law.

episodes.title: Odcinek 3
episodes.summary: As caring for Tosia becomes increasingly difficult -- and complicates one of his closest relationships -- Filip furthers his commitment to adopting his niece, only to be hit with a troubling reality check.

episodes.title: Odcinek 4
episodes.summary: Filip begins to make serious changes to his home and patterns of behavior, but an early visit from the social worker throws everything into disarray.

episodes.title: Odcinek 5
episodes.summary: Given a rare second chance, Filip lands a steady job in a stock room, but emergencies at Tosia's daycare and with one of his agent's clients stand in the way of making it through the workday. Then, Paweł makes a startling declaration about their future.

episodes.title: Odcinek 6
episodes.summary: After being hit with a devastating wrinkle in his custody case, a desperate Filip goes on the run with Tosia with help from his neighbor. Meanwhile, his case and issues surrounding the rights of gay parents make national news.

episodes.title: Odcinek 7
episodes.summary: After committing to one another, Filip and Paweł head to the sea for a much-needed getaway -- but reality disrupts their trip. Then, the experience compels Filip to uncover part of his past.

episodes.title: Odcinek 8
episodes.summary: Filip takes Tosia to meet her paternal grandmother, Olga, and inadvertently opens a wormhole of complications between the two families. Then, Filip braces himself as Tosia's case is put in front of a judge.
